name: Split Text Menu Hero
description: Full-screen image hero with a top bar and a Menu button that opens a full-screen overlay of large italic links with split-text hover rolls and image pairs revealed beside each link.
contents: Top bar with brand link and Menu/Close pill toggle
Full-screen menu overlay with numbered links, dividers and two images per link
Hero image with gradient fade and a two-line headline with highlighted words
behavior: Menu opens with a clip-path wipe from top, dividers draw in, link text slides up, hero headline fades out
Closing reverses the wipe and fades the headline back
Hovering the brand or a link rolls the characters upward with an alternating stagger
Hovering a menu link wipes in two grayscale images that settle to color
Images beside links are hidden below the sm breakpoint

props.name: menuItems
props.default: 5 sample items (Home, About, Projects, Journal, Contact)

editableByProps: Brand, menu links, link numbers and two images per link
Hero image, alt text and both headline lines with highlighted words
Button labels, colors, open and close durations, character stagger

needsCodeEdit.where: display and mono font definitions at the top of the file

needsCodeEdit.change: Change menu link and image sizes
needsCodeEdit.where: navBottomRef container and the imageWrapperRefs blocks

fixed: Uses next/font/google for Fraunces and IBM Plex Mono, so it requires Next.js
Hero section and menu overlay are each full viewport height (h-screen)
Menu overlay is sized in vh units and the side images are hidden below the sm breakpoint
